prompt: A photorealistic 16:9 waist-up shot from a dated 1970s local TV den set, on slightly grainy colour film, the presenter's head large in the upper frame, the walls softening behind. Dark walnut panelling, brown-and-orange geometric wallpaper, a crammed bookshelf, an overflowing ashtray. A masked host leans out of a cracked oxblood leather armchair, pouring red wine from a heavy decanter into a glass he can never drink, head cocked at the camera. His olive moss-stitch wool balaclava covers his whole head as one unbroken knitted surface, slightly bobbled; a cream-white embroidered ring circles the face and a solid red felt triangle with rounded corners sits high inside it on the right side of the frame, at two o'clock. Black leather gloves each carry a small stitched patch of the same ring and triangle on the back, running into brown corduroy cuffs; a mustard roll-neck swallows the hood's neck. One warm table lamp lights him from frame left. Thanks.
